GOAL! Harbour City 2-1 Ironbridge Athletic. Okafor: a towering header from the corner. Reyes with the assist.

NO GOAL. Okafor's strike is ruled out: offside by a toenail.
Substitution, Ironbridge Athletic: Osei on for Bergstrom.
RED CARD! Dragovic (Ironbridge Athletic) is sent off for a last-man foul on Nakamura. Ironbridge Athletic are down to ten.

SAVED! Graves guesses right and palms it round the post. Valdes can't believe it.
Substitution, Harbour City: Mbeki on for Sinclair.
